scripts.build: npm run types && WRANGLER_LOG=none ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro check && WRANGLER_LOG=none ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build
scripts.db:migrate:local: WRANGLER_LOG=none wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:seed:local: npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:seed:sql && WRANGLER_LOG=none wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file .generated/seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: npm run db:migrate:remote && npm run db:seed:sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file .generated/seed.sql
